title: git.repo.test --auth skip runs a tier without keyrack
description:
## .wish

`rhx git.repo.test --auth skip` runs a test tier without a keyrack unlock.

## .why

a repo whose acceptance tier has a credential-free subset (e.g. `ehmpathy/rhachet`) can run that
subset locally with no keyrack. today `ehmpathy/rhachet` carries its own
`test.acceptance.credfree` skill to do it; that skill retires once this flag lands.

## .the outcome

- `--auth skip` skips the keyrack unlock that `--what integration|acceptance` performs
- the tier runs as asked; a test that needs a credential fails loud, never skipped silently
- `--help` names the flag

## .see

- ehmpathy/rhachet pr 699, review thread 4612853930
